_note: SPAWN-01: how a Foamer from a wave or a trigger teleports in, instead of popping into being. seconds: the whole arrival; the Foamer cannot move, attack or be hit until it ends. portalShare: the share of that time the foam ring spends opening before the body starts to grow. growFrom: the body's starting scale. growShare: the share of the time after the portal spent growing to the overshoot; the rest settles back to 1. overshoot: the scale it swells to just before it settles at 1 (a foam squash). look: the effect drawn at the feet (src/foamers/spawn-fx.ts), its colours in the foam palette, sizes in metres. maxLive: the hard cap on arrivals drawn at once; past it a Foamer still arrives, without the effect. Start values, [Paul] to tune.
